data.summary: All five commits landed on main and pushed; make test lint green after each. The TUI is now bare `tuhdoo` (TTY-guarded; non-TTY gets usage exit 1), `-w/--watch` disarms it with a header badge, watch/top verbs are tombstones, header carries badge+sync+counts, enter opens an in-place read-only detail screen (esc back, q quit, j/k line-window scroll, live off the 2s snapshot), and rows carry edge-marker suffixes (· in <parent> · N deps). One planned scenario didn't exist: "uninitialized repo → init hint" — the daemon auto-creates the data branch, so only non-git-dir errors (openRepo's message covers it). One-shot commands untouched. Follow-ups already filed: t-01KYT63MB28Z535SMJCA63RQJM (armed detail), t-01KYT63MB28Z535SMJCBC7SY1P (tree rendering, gated on edge-semantics grill). Not manually smoke-tested in a real terminal — Brandon should run bare `tuhdoo` and `tuhdoo -w` in tmux once.
